title: Create a Presentation with Text, Images, and Tables
description: Build a 6-slide presentation about 'My City' using multiple layouts, themes, images, tables, and SmartArt
objective: Students will create a complete PowerPoint presentation using different slide layouts, apply a theme, insert images, tables, and SmartArt, and add headers and footers.

steps.title: Create a New Presentation with Title Slide
steps.instructions:
1. Open **Microsoft PowerPoint** (Start Menu → search PowerPoint)
2. Click **Blank Presentation** to start fresh
3. You will see a slide with the **Title Slide** layout
4. Click on **"Click to add title"** and type: **"Bhopal — The City of Lakes"** (or your own city name)
5. Click on **"Click to add subtitle"** and type: **"Presented by [Your Name] | CCC Batch 2026 | TechPath Institute"**
6. Now apply a theme:
   - Go to the **Design** tab in the Ribbon
   - Browse through the available themes
   - Click on a theme you like (try **Facet** or **Ion** for a modern look)
   - Notice how the slide design changes immediately
7. Save your presentation:
   - Press **Ctrl + S**
   - Navigate to your Desktop
   - File name: `MyCity_YourName.pptx`
   - Click **Save**

**CCC Exam Fact:** The default first slide uses the **Title Slide** layout. PowerPoint files are saved with the **.pptx** extension.

steps.title: Add Content Slides with Text and Images
steps.instructions:
1. **Insert Slide 2 (About My City):**
   - Press **Ctrl + M** to insert a new slide
   - The new slide uses the **Title and Content** layout by default
   - Type the title: **"About Bhopal"**
   - In the content area, type these bullet points:
     - Capital of Madhya Pradesh
     - Known as the City of Lakes
     - Population: approximately 23 lakhs
     - Famous for: Upper Lake, Bhojtal, VIP Road
     - Languages: Hindi, Urdu, English
   - Now insert a picture:
     - Go to **Insert** tab → **Pictures** → **Online Pictures**
     - Search for your city name and select an appropriate image
     - Click **Insert**
     - Resize the image by dragging a **corner handle** (hold **Shift** to maintain proportions)
     - Position the image on the right side of the slide

2. **Insert Slide 3 (Famous Places):**
   - Press **Ctrl + M** for a new slide
   - Right-click the new slide in the Slide Panel → **Layout** → **Two Content**
   - Title: **"Famous Places to Visit"**
   - Left content: List 4-5 famous places (Upper Lake, Bharat Bhavan, Tribal Museum, etc.)
   - Right content: Click the **picture icon** in the placeholder to insert an image

**CCC Exam Fact:** Use **Ctrl + M** to insert a new slide. The **Two Content** layout has two side-by-side content areas.

steps.title: Insert Tables and SmartArt
steps.instructions:
1. **Insert Slide 4 (Food and Culture) with SmartArt:**
   - Press **Ctrl + M** for a new slide
   - Title: **"Food and Culture"**
   - In the content area, click the **SmartArt icon** (colored boxes icon in the placeholder)
   - Select **List** → **Basic Block List**
   - Click **OK**
   - In the SmartArt text pane (or click directly on shapes), type:
     - Poha-Jalebi
     - Bhutte Ka Kees
     - Dal Bafla
     - Rogan Josh
     - Seekh Kebab
   - Use the **SmartArt Design** tab to change the color scheme

2. **Insert Slide 5 (Study Schedule) with Table:**
   - Press **Ctrl + M** for a new slide
   - Title: **"CCC Study Schedule"**
   - Go to **Insert** tab → **Table** → select a **4 columns x 5 rows** grid
   - Fill the table with this data:

   | Week | Module | Topic | Hours |
   |------|--------|-------|-------|
   | 1 | 01 | Computer Intro | 6 |
   | 2 | 07 | Email | 4 |
   | 3 | 08 | Presentations | 8 |
   | 4 | — | Revision | 6 |

   - Use the **Table Design** tab to apply a table style
   - Resize the table to fit nicely on the slide

**CCC Exam Fact:** SmartArt is found in the **Insert** tab and is used to create graphical diagrams. Tables can be inserted from Insert → Table.

steps.title: Add WordArt, Slide Numbers, and Footer
steps.instructions:
1. **Insert Slide 6 (Thank You) with WordArt:**
   - Press **Ctrl + M** for a new slide
   - Right-click the slide → **Layout** → **Blank**
   - Go to **Insert** tab → **WordArt**
   - Select a decorative style (try the one with shadow or gradient)
   - Type: **"Thank You!"**
   - Resize and center the WordArt on the slide
   - Below it, insert a **Text Box** (Insert → Text Box)
   - Type: **"Presented by [Your Name] | TechPath Institute, Bhopal"**
   - Center the text box

2. **Add Slide Numbers and Footer:**
   - Go to **Insert** tab → **Header & Footer**
   - In the dialog box:
     - Check **Date and time** → Fixed → type **"July 2026"**
     - Check **Slide number**
     - Check **Footer** → type **"TechPath Institute — CCC Exam Preparation"**
     - Check **Don't show on title slide** (so the title slide stays clean)
   - Click **Apply to All**

3. **Verify:** Switch to **Slide Sorter View** (View tab → Slide Sorter)
   - You should see all 6 slides with slide numbers and footer on slides 2-6

**CCC Exam Fact:** Headers and Footers are inserted from the **Insert** tab. Slide numbers, date, and footer text can be applied to all slides or selected slides.

steps.title: Review and Save in Multiple Formats
steps.instructions:
1. **Review your presentation:**
   - Switch to **Normal View** (View tab → Normal)
   - Click through each slide and check for:
     - Spelling errors (Review tab → Spelling, or press **F7**)
     - Consistent fonts and sizes
     - Proper image placement
     - Table data accuracy

2. **Explore different views:**
   - Go to **View** tab → **Slide Sorter** — see all slides as thumbnails
   - Go to **View** tab → **Reading View** — preview as a windowed slide show
   - Press **F5** — run the full slide show from the beginning
   - Press **Esc** to exit the slide show
   - Go to **Slide 3**, then press **Shift + F5** — verify show starts from slide 3

3. **Save in different formats:**
   - **Save as PPTX:** Press **Ctrl + S** (already done)
   - **Save as PDF:** File → Save As → change type to **PDF** → Save as `MyCity_YourName.pdf`
   - **Save as PPSX:** File → Save As → change type to **PowerPoint Show (.ppsx)** → Save as `MyCity_YourName.ppsx`
     - Open the `.ppsx` file — notice it opens directly in slide show mode!

4. **Final save:** Ctrl + S

**CCC Exam Fact:**
- **F5** starts slide show from the **first slide**
- **Shift + F5** starts from the **current slide**
- **.pptx** is editable, **.ppsx** opens as a slide show, **.pdf** is non-editable
